# Convertify

> Convertify (https://convertify.work) is a free set of PDF, image and data conversion tools that run in the web browser. Files are processed on the user's own device with JavaScript and are not uploaded to a server. No account, no watermark.

## Facts

- Price: free. No paid tier.
- Privacy: conversion runs locally in the browser; files are not uploaded. Anyone can confirm this in the browser's Network tab while converting.
- Account: none needed.
- Watermark: none added.
- File size: up to 200 MB per file.
- Platforms: any modern browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android and iOS.
- Android app: "Convertify" on Google Play (package com.convertify.work), with a camera document scanner and offline conversion.

## Known limitations

- Excel to PDF writes cell values as text (all columns, long text wrapped). Cell colours, borders, charts and images are not carried over, and characters outside Western European scripts print as "?".
- Watermark PDF adds a text watermark; it is a visual stamp, not tamper-proof protection.
- There is no OCR (text recognition). Scanned PDFs stay image-only.
- Image Compressor re-encodes to JPEG; PNG and WebP transparency becomes white.

## PDF tools

- [Merge PDF](https://convertify.work/merge-pdf): combine PDFs into one file, drag to reorder
- [Split PDF](https://convertify.work/split-pdf): extract pages or ranges into separate PDFs
- [Compress PDF](https://convertify.work/compress-pdf): shrink a PDF toward a target size you set in KB or MB (e.g. 100 KB for government portals); reports when the target can't be reached
- [Rotate PDF](https://convertify.work/rotate-pdf)
- [Organize PDF](https://convertify.work/organize-pdf): reorder and delete pages
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://convertify.work/delete-pdf-pages)
- [Reorder PDF](https://convertify.work/reorder-pdf)
- [Crop PDF](https://convertify.work/crop-pdf)
- [Add Page Numbers](https://convertify.work/add-page-numbers)
- [Watermark PDF](https://convertify.work/watermark-pdf)
- [Sign PDF](https://convertify.work/sign-pdf)
- [Edit PDF](https://convertify.work/edit-pdf)
- [Redact PDF](https://convertify.work/redact-pdf): redacted pages are rasterized so the hidden text cannot be copied back out
- [Protect PDF](https://convertify.work/protect-pdf): add a password (AES-256)
- [Unlock PDF](https://convertify.work/unlock-pdf)
- [Repair PDF](https://convertify.work/repair-pdf)
- [Compare PDF](https://convertify.work/compare-pdf)
- [Scan Documents to PDF](https://convertify.work/ocr-pdf): camera scanner with page-edge detection and Original, Magic Color, Grayscale and Xerox filters; several pages into one PDF
- [Fit to Size](https://convertify.work/fit-to-size)
- [AutoCAD PDF Editor](https://convertify.work/autocad-pdf-editor): for PDFs exported from AutoCAD

## Convert to and from PDF

- [PNG to PDF](https://convertify.work/png-to-pdf): combine many PNGs into one PDF; images are embedded at their original resolution
- [JPG to PDF](https://convertify.work/jpg-to-pdf)
- [PDF to JPG](https://convertify.work/pdf-to-jpg): 150, 220 or 300 DPI
- [PDF to PNG](https://convertify.work/pdf-to-png): lossless, 150, 220 or 300 DPI
- [PDF to Word](https://convertify.work/pdf-to-word): extracts the text into an editable .docx
- [Word to PDF](https://convertify.work/word-to-pdf)
- [Excel to PDF](https://convertify.work/excel-to-pdf)
- [PDF to Excel](https://convertify.work/pdf-to-excel)
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://convertify.work/pdf-to-powerpoint)
- [PDF to Text](https://convertify.work/pdf-to-text)
- [Text to PDF](https://convertify.work/text-to-pdf)
- [HTML to PDF](https://convertify.work/html-to-pdf)
- [Markdown to PDF](https://convertify.work/markdown-to-pdf)
- [TIFF to PDF](https://convertify.work/tiff-to-pdf)
